episodes.synopsis: A witch, Zero, and a half-beast, Mercenary, form an unlikely alliance to begin their quest. Meanwhile, they are being stalked by a mysterious figure.
episodes.title: The Witch and the Beastfallen

episodes.synopsis: Albus joins Mercenary and Zero. With the new member in tow, the group heads out to a new village, but not all goes as planned.
episodes.title: Witch-Hunting

episodes.synopsis: The group comes upon the city of Formicum where they look to stay and rest. While there, Zero and Mercenary run into some trouble.
episodes.title: Duel

episodes.synopsis: As they make their way to Latette, Mercenary teaches Zero about different aspects of the world while also warming up to Albus.
episodes.title: The Road to Latette

episodes.synopsis: The three start their investigation into the massacre in Latette, leading Zero to meet someone from her past.
episodes.title: The Sorcerers of Zero

episodes.synopsis: Thirteen and Zero are determined to finish what they started. Meanwhile, they learn more about Thirteen's intentions, including why he chose to become Sorcerer of the State.
episodes.title: Thirteen

episodes.synopsis: Zero, betrayed by Mercenary's doubts about her, dissolves the agreement. Now alone, Mercenary finds himself helping out a young woman with a Beastfallen problem.
episodes.title: Plasta, the Royal Capital

episodes.synopsis: Mercenary learns more about Holdem's past while tending to his wounds. Meanwhile, Thirteen has sinister plans for Albus.
episodes.title: Sorena's Granddaughter

episodes.synopsis: With Mercenary, Holdem, and Albus on the run, they must figure out a way to free Zero from Thirteen's clutches.
episodes.title: Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Mercenary tries to save Zero from Thirteen, only to have his plans compromised. Meanwhile, Holdem and Albus face their own problems as they try to escape their captors.
episodes.title: The Truth Revealed

episodes.title: The Witch and the Sorcerer

episodes.synopsis: The battle for Wenias has begun! Will Mercenary and Zero's plan come to fruition or will it fail?
episodes.title: The Grimoire of Zero
